title: Time the Client Had the Market Closed Off, and the Share of an Outage Credit Allowed
content:
Where an approved suspension request stands on an Unattended Micro Market Program agreement over the quarter, only a share of the credit worked out is allowed, and the weight of the approved kiosk outage over the half year settles which share.

## Conditions

**The shared-cause share of 75 per cent** is allowed where the agreement carries an approved suspension request over the three months to the day the credit is worked out, and at or above 8 approved kiosk outage requests over the six months to that day, the rest being time the client had the market closed off.

**The client-cause share of 50 per cent** is allowed where the agreement carries an approved suspension request over those three months, and below 8 approved kiosk outage requests over those six months.

**Where no approved suspension request stands on the agreement over those three months**, no such reduction of the share is made.

## The boundary

The material outage hours figure is 8 approved kiosk outage requests over the six months to the day the credit is worked out: exactly 8 is at or above it, and 7 is below it. The suspension limb is met by a single approved suspension request standing over the three months.

*Hypothetical.* An agreement carrying one approved suspension request in the quarter and 9 approved kiosk outage requests over the half year has 75 per cent of the figure allowed; on a credit worked out at 400.00 USD that is 300.00 USD. Had only 5 approved kiosk outage requests stood over that half year, 50 per cent would be allowed, giving 200.00 USD. With no approved suspension request in the quarter, neither condition is reached.
